title: Jensen Huang reclaims throne at Nvidia: Here's the bottom line for investors
summary:
Nvidia's (NVDA) stock continued to waver in Wednesday's trading session, seemingly after the fanfare around CEO Jensen Huang's return had died down.

Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi shares his perspective on Huang's reinstatement and what it reflects in the chipmaker's stock moves.

title: Jensen Huang's return, neocloud risk, and a holiday retail rally
summary: In this special edition of Sozzi Unleashed: At The Close, Brian Sozzi warns that investors can be right about a tech revolution and still lose a fortune, lays out three reasons Nvidia may deserve another look after Jensen Huang's return, and explains why the debt-fueled neoclouds like CoreWeave and Nebius still make him nervous. Former federal prosecutor Gil Soffer, head of corporate investigations at Katten, joins to discuss how Nvidia's board probe proceeds with Huang back in charge and whether he could be fired again. Brian also connects the dots on the AI build-out and inflation with a clip from Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee, and makes the case for a strong holiday season for retailers with comments from Walmart CFO John David Rainey and Gap CEO Richard Dickson.

title: Nvidia is cheap on paper, so why won't the market buy it?
summary: Market Hang tackles the top stories of the day. Including Nvidia giving back about half of its Jensen Huang rally and why a stock growing sales 60% to 70% can trade at 10 times earnings, whether the Alice Wong affair was a "hit job," and what next week's Senate testimony means for the stock.
